statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail rises from 15 to 20 because the single observation that capped the previous reading has been invalidated: the session low did not hold at 29,371.75 but extended to 29,333.25, and NQ now trades at 29,361.75, down 177.00 points or 0.60% on the 29,538.75 settle. E-mini S&P 500 futures at 7,646.50 (-0.44%) sit near their own session low of 7,644.50. Cross-assets are fully aligned against equities: the 10-year is 4.81%, its highest since October 2023, the 2-year is 4.43%, Brent is $100.91 up 3.05% and VIX at 16.55 is printing at its session high rather than below it. Stress rises to 83 on that alignment. Tail remains below the block threshold because the absolute decline is 0.60%, price has retraced about 29 points off the low rather than pinning to it, and the U.S. cash session has not yet opened.
recommendation: Tail at 20 maps to WATCH for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD; it remains below the block threshold. The narrow evidence-based danger window covers 13:30-15:00 UTC, the U.S. cash open and first full hour, which is the material checkpoint because the opening auction now meets a range that has already broken and re-broken rather than a balanced one. A secondary checkpoint sits at 17:00 UTC, where the 10-year note auction into a 4.81% yield coincides with the Apple keynote, and a third at the 19:00 UTC power hour. Existing-position management, exits and emergency protection remain active throughout. Stress at 83 describes an extreme macro backdrop, not an observed mean-reversion failure, and on its own it does not change the mapped state.
headline: NQ extends to a 29,333.25 session low and trades at 29,361.75, -0.60%, with VIX at its session high and Brent through $100.90; tail steps to 20 and the mapped state moves to WATCH ahead of the cash open
body:
The qualification that held tail at 15 an hour ago no longer applies. That assessment rested on NQ having stopped extending roughly 20 points above a 29,371.75 session low. The low did extend: NQ has since printed 29,333.25, some 38.5 points lower, and the day's range is now 29,333.25 to 29,633.75. Price at 29,361.75 is down 177.00 points or 0.60% on the 29,538.75 settle, and Investing.com corroborates the same picture at 29,349.00 against an identical previous close and low. Two consecutive hours of lower lows into an unopened cash session is the first genuinely persistent directional structure of this sequence, and it is why tail moves from 15 to 20 and the mapped state from EA_ON to WATCH.

The cross-asset picture has hardened rather than merely persisted. The 10-year at 4.81% is the highest since October 2023 and the 2-year at 4.43% is firm with it, both supported by energy rather than by growth. Brent at $100.91 is up 3.05% and through the $100 mark for the first time since July, after U.S. strikes on Iranian tankers near the Kharg Island export hub and Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure; Strait of Hormuz traffic has fallen to a fraction of pre-war volumes. VIX at 16.55 is up 5.29% and is printing at its session high, where an hour ago it was off it. European equities are weaker in the same channel, with the Stoxx Europe 600 down 1.2% and German bund yields at post-2011 highs. Latest-session breadth context is one-directional too: seven of eight megacaps and all seven tracked semiconductor names closed lower, with semiconductor equipment down 1.73%. That is an aligned amplifier stack rather than a single signal.

Three things keep the step measured and hold tail well inside the watch band rather than pushing it toward the block threshold. The absolute decline is 0.60%, which is a modest move in a contract whose day range spans 300 points. Price has retraced about 29 points off the low rather than pinning to it, so the no-retracement path that actually threatens a mean-reversion approach is not observed. And the U.S. cash session has not opened, so the opening auction that would confirm or invalidate continuation is still ahead. The escalation itself, the yield level and the release calendar are scored primarily into stress at 83 and into confidence, not into tail; that distinction is deliberate.

Confidence holds at 87. Live NQ pricing was cross-checked against two independent sources, VIX, both Treasury tenors and Brent were read from primary quote pages, and shared cross-asset context collected at 11:59 UTC is well inside its freshness bound and agrees with the direct reads. No Tier-1 U.S. release falls inside the forecast window; PPI and jobless claims arrive at 12:30 UTC on 10 September, immediately after it closes.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock-hours the mapped state was EA_ON in every published hour, with tail between 5 and 15. The two elevated prints were both 15: one at 14:00 UTC on 8 September during a brief trend-down phase in the first full U.S. cash hour, which reverted within the same hour, and one at 11:00 UTC on 9 September when the overnight band broke. One hour, 10:00 UTC on 9 September, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable. Stress climbed almost without interruption from 70 to 81 across the window as crude advanced through $99 and then above $100, the 10-year reached its highest level since October 2023 and pricing for a September increase firmed. The defining pattern was rising macro stress against repeatedly orderly, two-sided price discovery in the index. That pattern broke in the final hour of the window, and the current assessment records the follow-through.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours contain no Tier-1 U.S. macro release; PPI and jobless claims at 12:30 UTC on 10 September fall immediately outside the window, CPI on 11 September and the 16 September FOMC decision well outside it. Conditional tail runs in a 11-23 band and never approaches the block threshold, peaking at 23 in the first full U.S. cash hour inside the 13:30-15:00 UTC danger window, where an opening auction meeting a twice-broken overnight range is the specific failure mode of concern. Four slots covering 12:00-15:00 UTC sit in the watch band; every later slot maps back to EA_ON. Secondary steps sit at 17:00 UTC, where the 10-year note auction into a 4.81% yield coincides with the Apple keynote and is labelled event/whipsaw for two-sided reaction risk, and at the 19:00 UTC power hour. Conditional tail then eases to an 11-12 trough across the Asian handover before rebuilding through the European session toward 16 in the final hour before PPI. Forecast confidence decays from 87 to 63 with distance, which reflects forecast horizon rather than any gap in the current evidence base.
